tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lha mo shra wa ṇa'i sgo nas rmi brtag sgrub tshul dus gsum blang dor rab gsal bzhugs so// oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ mkhyen bzang utpal dgod pa'i 'dzum phreng rtser/ /snying rje'i bung ba rol pa'i zlos gar las/ /thub bstan sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston 'gyed cha can/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas/ /gzhan la lkog tu gyur pa shes bya'i gnas/ /mngon sum nyid du lta bar byed pa'i thabs/ /man ngag rin chen gsal ba'i me long gang / /blo gsal skye bo'i tshogs la sbyin par bya/ /lha mo shra wa ṇa'i sgo nas rmi lam brtag pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas ljon shing gi drung ngam brag phug gam/ de ma grub kyang khyi sgra sogs kyis dben pa'i dgon gnas su phyags brdar dang spos chus chag chag btab/ gu gul gyis bdug bla re yol ba la sogs pa ci 'byor gyis brgyan/ rang gi sngas 'gor stegs bu gru bzhi'i steng du padma 'dab brgyad bri/ de'i dbus su bum pa sman bzang po dang / 'o ma dang zho mar/ 'bru sna dang bcas pa'i chu gtsang gis dgang / shing gi yal gas kha brgyan/ steng nas dar sngon po'i gur phub/ bum pa'i steng du sgrol ma'i sku yod na bzhag rgyun du bzhag rgyu'i dkar gtor gsum yang bshams/ mtha' skor du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pa mtshams 'dzin me tog bcas kyis bskor ba'am/ yang na sbreng tshar du bshams/ sbyin bdag gi ched du yin na des smod 'bru gtsang ma dang rang gi ched du yin na mdun du 'thor nas bshams la me tog 'bul ba'i tshe smod bor bas 'thus so/ /gzhan yang rdor dril sogs nyer mkho rnams 'dus byas/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ yar ngo'i gza' tshes dge bar rdor dkar la gnas pa'i bcad rgya byas la mdun gyi mchod pa rnams/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo ke ghandhaṃ/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dharmā ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba buddha kṣe tra/ pra tsa li ni/ pra dzñā pa ra mi tā nā da swa bhā we na badzra dharma hri da ya ni/ santo ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥhoḥhoḥ.āḥkhaṃ swāhā/ zhes brjod/ de nas bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la༞dam pa'i chos rnams la༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la༞ zhes pa'i skyabs 'gro nyer gcig la sogs pa byed/ de nas bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blangs bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bor padma dang zla ba'i steng du rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po g.yas rdo rje thugs khar 'dzin pa/ g.yon dril bu dkur bsten pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan par bsgom/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par aḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rdo rje sems dpa' oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas rdo rje sems dpa' dang gnyis su med par bsam/

bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab rdo rje sems dpa'i sku las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi babs/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag lus thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ badzra satwa sa mā ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra satwa te no pa/ tiṣṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba siddhi me pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badzra ma me muñtsa badzri bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ zhes pa dang / oṃ badzra satwa a/ zhes snying po ci nus bzlas la/ thal mo sbyar te/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa dang ltung ba dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu ste spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mor gsal ba'i thugs kar padma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i raṃ yig dkar po las 'od zer 'phros pas rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ bsdu rgya se gol gyis spyan drangs/ thal mo sbyar la/ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ na maḥ.ārya tā ra ya/ zhes phyag bya/ oṃ ārya tā ra arghaṃ nas shapta āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma'i steng du rang gi sems nyid hūm̐ du gyur pa las 'od 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur bla re me 'od dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che bar gyur/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re rakṣa rakṣa swāhā/ zhes phreng skor tsam bzlas/ de lta bu'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du paṃ las padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid raṃ yig dkar po de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum g.yas mchog sbyin dang / g.yon padma dkar po'i yu ba mtheb srin gyis thugs kar 'dzin cing / 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba/ dbu skra mthon mthing ral pa'i zur phud ltag par bcings shing / lan bu ring du 'phyangs pa/ dar dmar pos stod g.yogs pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing / sku las 'phros pa'i 'od zer dkar pos 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gsal bar byed pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i raṃ yig dkar po las 'od zer 'phros pas rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ bsdu rgya se gol gyis spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang raṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ bsdu rgya se gol gyis spyan drangs/ thal mo sbyar la/ oṃ a bhi ṣīñtsa tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur sku gang /

dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ ārya tā ra sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa'i sngags la pra tītstsha swāhā btags pas mchod/ thal sbyar ram/ dril gsil gang rung gis/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma/ /tuttā ra yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol/ /tu res na ba rnams las sgrol/ /sgrol ma yum la phyal 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ rang gi thugs ka'i raṃ yig las sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus rang la thim/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swāhā/ zhes phreng skor tsam bzlas pa'i mthar/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ gdan 'od zer ma'i rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ sngas mgo'i bum pa a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bum pa rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i ri rab/ shar shel/ lho baiḍūrya/ nub padma rā ga byang gser las grub pa/ de'i steng du kha rgyan dpag bsam gyi shing lo ma dang me tog rgyas pa/ ri rab steng dpag bsam shing gi drung du/ padma dang zla ba'i gdan la lha mo shra wa ṇa sku mdog sngon po sked pa phra ba/ nu ma rgyas pa/ mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i cha byad can/ ri rab la stegs 'dug gi tshul du bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ phyag g.yas me long dang rnga yab/ g.yon dpag bsam gyi shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa/ shes bya thams cad gsal bar lung ston pa'i skur gyur/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas lha mo shra wa ṇa la bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ bsdu rgya se gol gyis spyan drangs/ oṃ gu ru trai ratna shra wa ṇa arghaṃ nas shapta āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim pas steng gi nam mkha' la bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par gyur/

mchod pa bsang sbyang byin rlabs gong bzhin/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho sogs tshigs bcad dang spel nas mchod pa'am/ yang na oṃ gu ru sogs sngon 'gro'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo rnams kyis sngags kyi mthar pra tītstsha swāhā btags pas mchod/ dril gsil lam thal sbyar gang rung gis/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku sogs bla bstod/ ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che sogs dkon mchog gi bstod pa/ ma rig 'khrul pa'i sems can la/ /yang dag don rnams gsal mdzad pa'i/ /rje btsun sgrol ma thugs rje can/ /shra wa ṇa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen las grub ri rab steng / /dpag bsam shing drung pad zla la/ /'khyil stegs tshul gyis rab bzhugs pa/ /shra wa ṇa la༞ /and+ra nī la'i mdangs ldan sku/ /mdzes shing rab sgeg yid 'ong ba/ /dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /shra wa ṇa la༞ /phyag g.yas me long rnga yab kyis/ /shes bya ston cing rmongs pa sel/ /phyag g.yon dpag bsam yal ga yis/ /dgos 'dod stsol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /phrin las gcig bsdus rje btsun mar/ /bdag gis gus pas bstod pa'i mthus/ /rab 'byams dus gsum gsal mthong shog /ces bstod la/ rang gzhan gyi smod 'bru thal mo'i bar bzung nas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang / khyad par bcom ldan 'das shra wa ṇas bdag gi yid la re ba'i don 'dis thog drangs dus gsum gyi blang dor thams cad mngon sum bzhin du shes nus pa'i phrin las dang stong grogs mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod la rten la me tog gtor/ de 'dra lan nyer gcig nas gsum gyi bar byas la/ sems kyi lha mo shra wa ṇas rang gi yid la yod pa'i don de'i thog drangs blang dor thams cad gsal bar ston par bsam la mdun gyi skyabs gnas rnams blo la gsal 'debs dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas/ oṃ shra wa ṇa pi sha tsi ni muṇḍe swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzlas/

thun 'phro 'jog pa na'ang gong bzhin 'dod gsol dang mchod bstod byas la gtor ma dang po a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod nas byin gyis brlabs mdzod rgya'i mthar se gol reg la/ oṃ gu ru trai ratna shrā wa ṇa na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa nas ba lingta ye swāhā btags pa gsum gyis bla ma dkon mchog dang shra wa ṇa la phul/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo bstod pa 'dod gsol rnams gong bzhin/ gtor ma gnyis pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa dang / mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ bsdu rgya se gol rdor thal gyi mthar se gol gtogs pa dang oṃ shri ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wī ye/ dharma pā la tsa tur mu kha karma nā tha sa pā ri wā ra na maḥsarba sogs btags pa gsum gyis phul/ oṃ arghaṃ nas/ shapta āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ thal sbyar ram dril gsil gang rung gis/ gong gi 'khrul dang sogs kyis bstod/ dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma khyed rnams kyis bdag gi yid la re ba'i don 'dis sogs gong bzhin 'phrin bcol/ gtor ma gsum pa 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya las mdzub mo bkug pa dang / bhū mi ta sa pa ri wā ra a karṣa ya dzaḥ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro nas/ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā'i bar lan gsum/ rdor thal se gol dang bcas pas bsngo/

thal mo sbyar la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thal sbyar ram dril bu rgyun chag gang rung gis/ mchod sbyin gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi gtso byas pa'i 'dzam bu gling bzhi'i bdag po rnams dang / khyad par du bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis/ sgos dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ bye brag tu yul phyogs dang / sa phyogs 'di nyid na gnas pa'i lha klu/ btsan/ bdud/ rgyal po/ ma mo/ sa bdag gnyan mthu bo che/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag grong bdag dkor bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /'jig rten gyi khams su char chu dus su 'bab pa/ lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa/ mi nad phyugs nad mu ge thams cad rgyun chad cing mi 'byung ba/ dus kyi 'khrug pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad 'gro na ma chags 'dug na ma dogs/ 'gro ba la bshol 'debs ma byed/ sdod pa la bskul ma ma byed/ gnas mgron gyi dam tshig srung / bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad 'gro 'dug bya ba spyod lam ci byed kyang ru nga ba dang phrag dog ma mdzad par chos dang mthun pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang / khyad par bdag gi yid la re ba'i sogs gong bzhin 'phrin bcol/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs nongs bshags/ rten yod na phyogs bcu na sogs brtan bzhugs/ med na oṃ khyed kyis sogs gshegs bsdu/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs go bgo dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rje btsun sgrol ma 'grub gyur nas sogs/

rje btsun sgrol ma khyed sku ci 'dra dang sogs/ khyed la mchod cing sogs/ ston mchog dam pa sogs bsngo smon bkra shis bya'o/ /thun bzhi byed na thor thun/ snga thun/ dgong thun/ thun gsum la 'di bzhin dang / srod thun la bzlas pa'i mjug gi mchod bstod 'dod gsol rdzogs nas gnyis kyi mtshams sbyar/ tho rangs ldang ba'i tshod la gnyid sad pa dang gtor 'bul sogs thun gyi rjes rnams byas pa thor thun la 'jug de lta bu'i tshul gyis bsnyen pa byed tshul ni kun mkhyen bkra shis rnam pas mdzad pa'i shra wa ṇa'i sgrub thabs las 'di dag khri phrag gcig bsnyen pa byas na sa 'og gi gter mthong bar bshad pas de lta'i rim pa la 'bad par bya zhing / nub mo nyal khar lhag par yang 'bad/ 'dun pa rtse gcig pas lha mo'i pang du mgo bzhag par bsams pas/ mgo byang du bstan/ g.yas 'og tu bcug la nyal/ gnyid la 'gro khar sngags ci nus bzlas/ sems ma yengs pa gal che/ mtshams byed pa'i dus su mi khyi sogs dang mi 'phrad par byed cing / rab bsnyung gnas chig dril/ de ma grub kyang phyi dro'i kha zas dang / sha chang sngo tshod kyi rigs dang / khyad par sgog btsong dang la phug mi za/ dus thams cad du bshags pa la 'bad/ thun mtshams su sgrol ma 'don/ zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ zas za ba'i tshe phud bla ma dang shra wa ṇa la phul/ rang sgrol ma'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas za/ nangs par langs ma thag dang / bza' zos rjes dang / dri chu dor ba'i rjes su'ang chab blangs/ de ltar 'bad na rab zhag gsum/ 'bring lnga/ tha ma bdun nas 'grub ste dngos su lung ston pa'am/ brda'i tshul du gsal bar 'gyur/ gal te mi gsal na bskyar bas gsal bar 'gyur/ brda'i tshul du dpyad shes par bya/ ngan na bzlog pa'i thabs bstan du gsol zhes bri/ dang po don gcig brtag de nas 'ga' yang rim pas brtag tshul 'di skye ba snga phyi dang / rang gzhan kun gyi don thams cad gsal bar nus te/

'di las mchog tu gyur pa'i rmi lam sgrub thabs med par bla ma rnams gsungs shing myong bas kyang grub lags/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud nas gsung / zhag bdun nas ma grub na/ sgrib pa shas che ba yin/ bshags sdom la 'bad/ lan gsum bskyar na mi 'grub pa mi srid do/ /dkor dang grib chen gyi zas la 'dzems pa gal che'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas de bzhin du bya'o/ /zhes lha mo shra wa ṇa'i sgo nas rmi brtag sgrub tshul 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis dwags po paṇa chen bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi gsung la gzhi byas/ gong 'og gi 'tshams rnams rgyud sde dang mi 'gal phyin nyams su len bde ba rang gal che bas de bzhin du bsgrigs pa 'di 'gal 'khrul nongs pa'i tshogs cung zad kyang med cing bkras rnam pa'i sgrub thabs su bsnyen pa'i sngon du zhag gnyis gsum tsam zhig gtor ma dang bsrung 'khor nan chen bya bar bshad pas de dag ni gtor ma brgya rtsa sogs gtor ma rgyas bsdus gang rung dang uṣṇi ṣa dang brag rdzong ma sogs srung 'khor gang rung la 'bad na 'thus shing go chod pa sngon 'gro'i tshul du zhag shas de ltar bya zhing / dngos gzhi'i skabs chos skyong gi gtor 'bul 'di ni rang gang rten gyi chos skyong la 'bul ba las/ gur zhal sogs nges par mi dgos shing / chos skyong brten pa dmigs bsal med na rgyal chen bzhi la phul bas 'thus pas de ltar shes par bya'o// //maṅgalaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ lha mo shrawaṇa'i sgo nas rmi brtag sgrub tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
